Corrected native replay in [32ae97a8](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/commit/32ae97a8222affd8fe467cceedf3834d9a01cabd). The full export now uses the existing CI path `output/mim-kgx-710-full`; the native semantic builder names that bundle and hashes its actual manifest. This correction changes neither the CI workflow nor its replay test and does not patch review JSON by hand.

All **13 native refresh commands exit 0**, and the combined maltose/CI replay tests pass **28/28 cases**. [Native orchestration evidence](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/blob/8417aaf3a057d855ae5d0b78a587ef1cb57bf28f/reports/step7d_mapping_901_20261103/resumption/step7d-post1122-orchestration-v1.json) and [independent execution audit](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/blob/8417aaf3a057d855ae5d0b78a587ef1cb57bf28f/reports/step7d_mapping_901_20261103/resumption/independent-review/post1122-execution-review.json) retain prior outputs and the unchanged companion claims. The full-graph semantic release verdict remains `FAIL`; successful integrity and supported-subset checks do not authorize full-graph release.

PR: [#1128](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/pull/1128), publication head `8417aaf3a057d855ae5d0b78a587ef1cb57bf28f`. [Completed local validation](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/blob/8417aaf3a057d855ae5d0b78a587ef1cb57bf28f/reports/step7d_mapping_901_20261103/resumption/final-local-validation-v1.json) records **5,086 passed, zero failed, one pre-existing skip, 33 warnings**, with `just qc`, unified freshness and unified rejection checks passing. The later 515 changed paths are evidence-only; implementation and scientific inputs retain the tested checkpoint's bytes. **CI completion and final independent review are PENDING in this implementation update.** No merge or issue closure is claimed.
